description: This file contains shell functions and scripts for system upgrade operations, including file installation, hook execution, device detection, and firmware flashing.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies files to a target directory, creating symlinks for symbolic links and copying regular files.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Installs a binary file and its linked libraries.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Executes a list of functions with a given argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no answer, returning true for yes.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Outputs verbose messages if verbosity level is high.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON output.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Reads a file and optionally decompresses it based on magic bytes.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads the magic word (first two bytes) of a file.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads the magic long (first four bytes) of a file.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Detects and exports boot device information based on kernel command line.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports partition device name based on major/minor device numbers.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts a little-endian 32-bit hex string to CPU byte order.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads partition table from a device and outputs partition info.

methods.name: indicate_upgrade
methods.description: Sets system state to indicate an upgrade process.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by writing image to MTD device.
